title: Moving the sine wave by mentally humming a tone
place_text: Undisclosed facility near the NSA complex, Maryland

tellings.quote: looking at the box. When I saw the the the sine wave move, it it is like it came into focus.

plain: A former Air Force sergeant named Dan Sherman says that between 1990 and 1993, at a hidden facility near the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that listens to signals, in Maryland, he learned to move a wave line on a screen just by humming a tone in his head. He tells it first hand, saying that when he saw the wave move "it came into focus," as part of his account, told in a book called Above Black, of being trained to talk to aliens with his mind.
